_: Sanhua's textures: the hash WWMI-Assets / the download folder files them under (2.5) -> the hash the game binds with its texture quality (LOD bias) on Ultra High. 3DMigoto rehashes a streamed texture as its mips load, so on that setting a mod's override on the left-hand hash never fires and the game's texture is drawn under the mod's UVs. Measured off frame dumps: 2026-09-20 (max LOD) and 2026-10-05 at WuWa 3.7 (FrameAnalysis-Sanhua37Base, the character menu, every pair visible there re-confirmed; bf702e2d and 693b1360 are bound by passes that frame does not draw). Feed it to Tools/Misc/Diagnostics/wwmiTextureFix.py as --live: each override it keeps or updates gets a twin on the other hash, so the mod works on either setting.
